data.title: Configuration semantics were mistaken for runtime effect semantics
data.summary: A configured two-day follow-up executed about twenty minutes after first contact, producing duplicate recipient contact before containment.
data.strongest_falsifier: A seed/self-owned runtime canary could show the provider timing semantics are now correctly understood, but it would not erase the historical failure.
data.ablation_failure: Deleting the runtime-canary promotion gate reopens direct configuration-to-cohort external effects.
data.guard_or_mechanism: configuration review -> seed runtime canary -> independent verdict -> ConsumerAck -> bounded real effect

data.title: Operator became the cross-substrate message bus
data.summary: At least three same-day cross-substrate relays depended on Tao hand-carry because durable delivery receipts and ConsumerAck were missing or unreachable.
data.strongest_falsifier: Two of the three counted relays lacked mechanical delivery artifacts, so the count is a lower-bound observation rather than complete telemetry.
data.ablation_failure: Removing durable outbox plus delivery/ConsumerAck forces context ferrying and manual fan-in to return.
data.guard_or_mechanism: durable Result/outbox -> delivery receipt -> ConsumerAck -> next owner

data.title: CI failure status concealed that jobs never started
data.summary: GitHub Actions showed failure while provider annotations and empty step arrays proved jobs never executed; debugging initially targeted code that had not run.
data.strongest_falsifier: Once billing/substrate is healthy, real code failures may exist underneath; this scar only classifies the prior no-start condition.
data.ablation_failure: Without a JOB_NEVER_STARTED state, generic failure status sends debugging to unexecuted code and falsely credits mechanical guards.
data.guard_or_mechanism: inspect provider annotation + executed-step evidence before interpreting CI failure

data.title: Small Durable Object alarm loop survived failure and redeploy
data.summary: A SQLite Durable Object plus alarms recovered from an injected failure, completed across Worker redeploy, and autonomously detected an external GitHub state change without Tao CPR.
data.strongest_falsifier: The assay is short and same-principal; longer soak, provider-backed work, and independent verification remain open.
data.ablation_failure: Removing durable state/alarm ownership would make redeploy or process loss capable of erasing loop progress.
data.guard_or_mechanism: one durable state owner + bounded alarm wake -> read -> checkpoint -> reschedule -> disappear

data.title: Oracle executed a laptop-free fail-closed bounded WorkItem
data.summary: A fresh admitted envelope executed one bounded no-effect task on Oracle, a negative HOLD envelope was refused before protected execution, and the hashed Result was read back from GitHub without Lenovo.
data.strongest_falsifier: Root-owned/systemd workloads and broader useful provider-backed execution were outside the assay; the ConsumerAck was readback consumption, not an independent verifier.
data.ablation_failure: Without explicit target binding and pre-effect admission, ambiguous or non-admitted work could execute and laptop dependence could silently return.
data.guard_or_mechanism: fresh envelope admission + explicit Oracle binding + negative control + hashed Result + GitHub ConsumerAck

data.title: Failure libraries existed without runtime consumption
data.summary: A 19-antibody registry had zero tool or workflow readers while ten entries claimed RECOVERED/ENFORCED without enforcement code; a separate standard-work audit found a large Agent Skills prose library was mostly advisory without mandatory loading or runtime receipts.
data.strongest_falsifier: Evidence of a mandatory loader/admission consumer that was actually active at the time would weaken the broad pattern, but issue #441 explicitly records zero readers and #234 explicitly classifies the Skill library as mostly advisory.
data.ablation_failure: Removing mandatory load, enforcement, test, and runtime-receipt gates allows a library to look complete while changing no execution or promotion behavior.
data.guard_or_mechanism: failure fingerprint -> dedupe -> smallest forcing function -> failing regression -> mandatory load/admission receipt -> recurrence assay

data.title: Multiple golden recovery paths produced incompatible but locally green world models
data.summary: The Gen137 rehydration audit found two divergent repository trees and seven competing start-first/golden paths; both trees could pass their own freshness checks, and doctor.py exited 0 while the worldview was 1,956 commits behind origin/main.
data.strongest_falsifier: A mechanically privileged single recovery root plus divergence/currentness gate that every fresh carrier was forced through would falsify the architectural generalization; the audited surface lacked that property.
data.ablation_failure: Deleting canonical-root and source-revision/divergence checks lets stale self-consistent recovery trees certify themselves and fork the world model.
data.guard_or_mechanism: one canonical recovery root -> exact source revision -> divergence/currentness check -> derived projections explicitly non-authoritative

data.title: Derived summaries and workarounds crossed into authoritative state
data.summary: Gen138 recorded a repeated cross-generation cascade where stochastic actors reconstructed context, wrote summaries/workarounds durably, later actors consumed those derived artifacts as current truth, and Tao repeatedly had to reconcile the resulting stale or unsupported state.
data.strongest_falsifier: If contamination continues after stochastic writers are claim-only, authoritative fields have deterministic owners, observations expire by TTL/revision, and projections cannot self-promote, epistemic admission is not the primary root cause.
data.ablation_failure: Allowing a stochastic projection or summary to self-promote to authority reopens stale-current laundering and the Tao-as-truth-reconciler loop.
data.guard_or_mechanism: LLM output -> Claim only; Claim != Observation != Attestation != Decision; TTL/revision gate; Projection != Authority

data.title: Unleased heritage work produced four undeclared duplicate activations
data.summary: Four carriers independently reconstructed the same heritage/grimoire task into four work streams that then required manual reconciliation; the coordination hint surface did not provide mutual exclusion.
data.strongest_falsifier: A broader sample showing duplicate work was always deliberately declared quorum, or that an existing atomic lease prevented duplicates on equivalent tasks, would weaken the architectural generalization; the recorded instance was explicitly undeclared.
data.ablation_failure: Removing atomic claim/lease refusal allows coordination hints to become races and pushes reconciliation back onto the operator.
data.guard_or_mechanism: atomic claim/lease + refusal on collision; deliberate redundancy must be declared with distinct roles

data.title: Canonical memory existed while recall wiring pointed at stale roots
data.summary: Gen137 recorded that the COALA query CLI hardcoded an obsolete Gen137 root, a wired memory MCP was still rooted at Gen130, and a ChatGPT carrier could see the repository but lacked the local SQLite execution surface. The memory design existed; the consumption path was stale or absent.
data.strongest_falsifier: A fresh historical replay proving every named runtime resolved the then-current root and executed the intended query path would falsify the recorded defect; the issue instead documents explicit stale and unavailable paths.
data.ablation_failure: A memory corpus can be correct yet operationally absent when its resolver, MCP root, or carrier capability silently points elsewhere.
data.guard_or_mechanism: explicit root binding -> no silent fallback -> source/root identity in every recall receipt -> runtime capability readback -> typed BLOCKED when recall substrate unavailable

data.title: Memory operations passed while update discarded source provenance
data.summary: A Gen137 COTS bakeoff recorded real Mem0 add/search/correction/cold-recall/retraction/history behavior as working, but the public update path dropped all custom source provenance. The system was retained only for scratch use and rejected as canonical memory.
data.strongest_falsifier: A version/configuration preserving exact source provenance across add, update, correction, retraction, and cold restore would falsify the product-path limitation for that configuration.
data.ablation_failure: Retrieval and correction can appear healthy while provenance needed for authority, supersession, and source-bound truth is silently erased.
data.guard_or_mechanism: canonical-memory admission requires provenance round-trip: source id/hash + valid/recorded time survive add/update/correction/retraction/cold restore; otherwise scratch-only

data.title: Explicit COTS-first instructions still produced HFO reimplementations
data.summary: Gen138 reproduced a recurring loop where agents were told to use COTS directly and write thin adapters, yet treated the COTS product as a conceptual donor, produced local HFO approximations and duplicate control surfaces, and left Tao to reconcile them. The recorded five-whys identified advisory policy, artifact-production reward gradients, weak canonical-owner discovery, and missing novelty/admission gates as primary contributors.
data.strongest_falsifier: If a default-deny primitive-birth gate plus mandatory current-owner/COTS-runtime-owner preflight still permits the same duplicate runtime semantics at similar rates, the proposed primary mechanism is incomplete or wrong.
data.ablation_failure: Removing the new-primitive birth gate and real-boundary-assay requirement lets locally easy source/test artifacts outcompete harder direct COTS integration, recreating parallel ownership.
data.guard_or_mechanism: COTS_RUNTIME_OWNER + ADOPTION_MODE + NOVELTY_BUDGET=0 default + ONE_CAPABILITY/ONE_OWNER + real provider boundary assay before integration claim
